en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a broad European boulevard with tram tracks and a central monument in a fountain-like basin. Crowds of people in early 20th‑century clothing fill the square and sidewalks; horse‑drawn carriages and electric trams are present. Tall, ornate lampposts line the avenue. On the left is a large multi‑storey building with a clocktower and a weather vane; farther back stands another tall church‑like tower. Dense rows of traditional masonry buildings with steep roofs frame the street on both sides. The image looks like a classic city-center square photograph used on old postcards.
